headline: 8 stories worth your time — mostly rules & risk. Start with: OpenAI Cuts Model Prices Amid Enterprises’ Concerns About AI Spend

items.title: OpenAI Cuts Model Prices Amid Enterprises’ Concerns About AI Spend
items.summary: The move indicates that a price war for AI models is underway.
items.whyItMatters: This moves your cost base. Even small per-seat changes compound when you are paying out of revenue rather than a budget line.
actions: Compare against what you currently pay for the same job and reprice if the gap is material.

items.title: Google Earth’s AI deepfake tool only lasted one day
items.summary: Google has shut down Google Earth feature it launched Thursday that allowed users to edit satellite images with text prompts using AI.
items.whyItMatters: An obligation, not an opportunity. Small businesses get caught out here because nobody is watching the rules full time.
actions: Brief anyone who can authorise a payment or a password reset on your behalf.

items.title: LinkedIn adds a button to report AI-generated ‘slop’
items.summary: LinkedIn is introducing new ways to reduce low-quality AI-generated posts, including a “seems like AI slop” reporting option. It's also replacing its own AI writing feature with a proofreading tool.
items.whyItMatters: Distribution work. Judge it by whether it gets you in front of more of the right people for the same effort.
actions: Use it to increase output on a channel that already converts — not to open a new one.

items.title: Disrupting a Criminal Scam Operation
items.summary: OpenAI disrupted a Cambodia-based scam operation using ChatGPT to support investment, romance, gambling, and impersonation schemes.
items.whyItMatters: An obligation, not an opportunity. Small businesses get caught out here because nobody is watching the rules full time.
actions: Brief anyone who can authorise a payment or a password reset on your behalf.

items.title: Friend, the lonely AI wearable, returns with a new voice and a much bigger price tag
items.summary: Friend, the AI wearable, can now talk to its users — for an enhanced price.
items.whyItMatters: This moves your cost base. Even small per-seat changes compound when you are paying out of revenue rather than a budget line.

items.title: Oracle Brings Google Gemini Models to Enterprise Customers
items.summary: The partnership aims to give users more choice when building AI agents and automating business processes.
items.whyItMatters: This is back-office time. Anything here competes directly with hours you are personally spending on admin.
actions: Pick the single most repetitive task in your week and see whether this covers it end to end.

items.title: Google nixes its Earth AI feature one day after launch, amid criticism it would spread misinformation
items.summary: A tool that allowed anyone to generate fake AI-generated imagery and superimpose it over real Google Earth maps quickly spurred backlash.
items.whyItMatters: Context rather than a task. Useful for deciding what to commit to next quarter and what to ignore.
actions: Background reading — no action needed today, but worth knowing.

items.title: Advancing responsible AI across Europe
items.summary: OpenAI shares how its safety, security, transparency, and provenance practices support responsible AI governance in Europe. The work will continue as the EU AI Act advances.
items.whyItMatters: An obligation, not an opportunity. Small businesses get caught out here because nobody is watching the rules full time.
actions: Note the compliance date and check whether your business size is in scope.
